en: The postcard is a black and white photograph depicting a scenic lakeside view with a small settlement in the foreground and the ruins of an old structure (likely a castle) on an island or peninsula in the midground. There are several buildings, a tall chimney, and a winding road. Trees and a forested area surround the lake, and the text 'ALŪKSNE. PILSdrupas.' appears on the lower part of the image.
